entities.name: Tomasz Pryliński
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tomasz Pryliński was a Polish architect and conservator active in Kraków during the foreign partitions of Poland. His main area of interest was the Polish Renaissance architecture. Some of his achievements included the design for major restoration of the Sukiennice Cloth Hall at the Kraków Main Square.
